facts.fact: Dawan Africa reports that Somalia's Data Protection Authority, established in 2023 after parliament approved a data protection law, is headed by Director Mohamed Noor Olow and on 20 May 2026 said it had begun registering data controllers and processors.
Dawan Africa reports that Somalia's Data Protection Authority, established in 2023, is led by a director, Mohamed Noor Olow, who spoke for it on 20 May 2026.
Dawan Africa reports that parliament approved a data protection law in 2023, after which the Data Protection Authority was established; it does not say the law was promulgated or commenced.

Dawan Africa reports that the Data Protection Authority said on 20 May 2026 it had begun registering data controllers and processors, with six-monthly assessments and 72-hour breach reporting announced; no decision is stated.
